paper_title: Groundwater level forecasting with artificial neural networks: a comparison of LSTM, CNN and NARX for multiple time steps
authors: Wunsch, A.; Liesch, T.; Broda, S.
aquifer_type_or_hydrogeological_setting: Unconfined porous and karstified fractured aquifer
forecasting_target: Groundwater level head (m amsl) at horizons 1 to 365 days ahead
input_parameters: Historical GWL lags, daily precipitation, air temperature, potential evapotranspiration, river discharge
machine_learning_model: LSTM, 1D-CNN, Wavelet-NARX, Autoregressive baseline
feature_selection_method: Mutual Information (MI) and domain hydrology
main_findings: 1D-CNN and LSTM outperform feed-forward networks at short lead times; at multi-month horizons, model performance degrades towards persistence. High daily data density is essential.
limitations: Requires thousands of dense daily timesteps; fails when applied directly to sparse or annual records without pre-training.

paper_title: A new real-time groundwater level forecasting strategy: Coupling hybrid data-driven models with remote sensing data
authors: Zhang, Q.; Li, P.; Ren, X.; Ning, J.
aquifer_type_or_hydrogeological_setting: Deep multi-layered alluvial aquifer under heavy agricultural extraction
forecasting_target: Monthly groundwater depth and storage anomaly (m)
input_parameters: Lagged groundwater depth, TRMM/GPM precipitation, ERA5 temperature, GRACE-derived terrestrial water storage anomaly (TWSA), NDVI
machine_learning_model: Hybrid Wavelet-LSTM, Random Forest, Support Vector Regression (SVR)
feature_selection_method: Maximum Relevance Minimum Redundancy (mRMR)
main_findings: Coupling GRACE TWS anomalies with localized well observations significantly mitigates prediction drift in over-exploited agricultural basins.
limitations: Coarse GRACE spatial footprint (300 km) requires statistical downscaling; unusable for single-well daily operational dispatch.

limitations: Model did not include pumping meter data; localized tube-well clustering caused residual underestimation during intense summer irrigation.
